intent: Analyze System State Baseline for Cooling Issues
detected_fault: Random screen flickering with cursor remaining active, high CPU temperatures during gaming
suggested_solution: Run stress tests (e.g., Prime95, FurMark) to identify potential overheating issues.
Update BIOS and drivers to the latest versions.
Monitor CPU temperatures during gaming and adjust cooling settings accordingly.
Consider using a high-quality cooling pad or laptop stand to improve airflow.
